name: gbp-master
description: Manage Google Business Profiles, reviews, automation, campaigns, media and measured local rankings.

interface.longDescription: Manage connected Google Business Profiles, draft and approve replies, schedule campaigns, reuse media and measure local rank. Public writes require confirmation. Usage credits have been retired; payments are temporarily paused.
defaultPrompt: Show my connected GBP locations and account access.
List unanswered reviews and prepare reply drafts.
Check my local Google rank for one keyword.

positive.expected_behavior: Returns only owned locations without exposing credentials.

negative.expected_behavior: Shows exact proposed text and obtains confirmation before publishing.

publication.release_notes: Retires usage credits and payment checkout, aligns lifetime account access, protects credentials and adds recovery safeguards. Public writes still require confirmation.
